show: This is Provia, a crypto escrow agent. It pays out only when a payment is proven.
say: This is Provia, a crypto escrow agent. It pays out only when a payment is proven. Here is how to use it.

show: Step 1 · Open the site. No wallet needed.
say: Step one. Open the site. You do not need a wallet. Move your mouse over the alert to see what the processor really says.
Step two. Click, try a forged payment. Provia locks a real trade, then checks the payment.
The payment does not exist, so Provia refuses it. No money moves, and you get a clear reason.

show: Try the other attacks: short payment · someone else’s payment · replay
say: Try the other attacks too. Paying too little, using someone else's payment, or reusing an old one. Each one is refused.

show: Step 3 · Click “Honest buyer” and watch each step
say: Step three. Click, honest buyer. Watch each step. First the payment is proven, then the trade rules are proven.

show: Verified on zkVerify · the escrow pays the buyer
say: The proof is checked on Z K Verify. About ninety seconds later, the escrow pays the buyer.
Step four. Open the public receipt. Every step is listed, with a link you can check yourself.

show: The release on Base Sepolia: 0.05 USDC to the buyer
say: Here is the release on the Base Sepolia explorer. The buyer received the coins.

show: The proof, verified on zkVerify mainnet
say: And here is the proof, verified on Z K Verify mainnet.
That is Provia. Try it yourself, at provia ten, dot vercel, dot app.
